goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann den Wandel von Familien- und Bildungsstrukturen beschreiben und gesellschaftliche Folgen ableiten.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: Two hypothetical family/education arrangements are linked by a question, with possible positive effects and coordination needs shown separately. The possible qualifier prevents unconditional causal claims; neither panel is dated or presented as a ranked household norm. Different adults participate in learning and care.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px the school, varied learning/care scene, central consequence question and two large effect/coordination groups remain distinguishable. Small slogans and sublabels are not compulsory.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px the possible benefits and coordination categories and concrete education/care arrangements are legible.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: Learning participants face their shared books correctly, and caregivers face children and learning tools. No readable inverted notebook or board is being used.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people, without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: The figure is not evidence of a chronological replacement of one family form or a guarantee that any specific policy produces every possible benefit.
goalTextStatus: Actual current canonical German title/description inspected and matched to bilingual E1 author candidate; no D/P gate attested by this image review.
